description: Deconstruction-as-form: state a drop, spend the middle taking the idea of a drop apart (silence, false drops, self-eating slams), permit one true climax past the midpoint, then close with a dark sub-bass coda that refuses resolution. Three climaxes, each darker: loudest / longest / darkest.
name: artificial_instruments

sections.name: Intro
sections.notes: Ambient/textural statement of tonic. Sparse, patient. A short pullback and riser right before the drop.

sections.name: Drop A (exposition)
sections.notes: First main groove, four-on-the-floor, no backbeat. Let it ride but interrupt it — micro-breaks keep it from settling.

sections.name: Deconstruction I
sections.notes: Dismantle the drop: cut-outs, stuttering fragments. One moment of near-total silence — the boldest gesture in the track. Then slam back.

sections.name: Breakdown valley
sections.notes: Near-silence valley. Brightest timbre in the piece — fragile, exposed. Let the emptiness be the section.

sections.name: False drops
sections.notes: Stage drops that collapse back into the valley. The drop failing IS the section — frustration as composition.

sections.name: Rebuild
sections.notes: Rolling groove returns, darker harmony. Two phrase waves with mini-valleys between — don't let it run straight.

sections.name: Valley + self-eating drop
sections.notes: A valley, a re-entry, then a hard slam that immediately collapses back into valley. The drop eats itself.

sections.name: Climb
sections.notes: The ONLY true linear build. 50+ seconds, uninterrupted, no dips. Deny relief the whole way — this is what makes the climax land.

sections.name: Climax
sections.notes: Loudest sustained passage. Harmonic lift at the peak (relative major). Then cut it dead — the peak gets no dwell time.

sections.name: Breakdown valley 2
sections.notes: Hard cut out of the peak. Shorter than valley 1 — stutter fragments, no rest.

sections.name: Second peak (stutter-groove)
sections.notes: Long deconstructed peak: loud groove chopped by irregular deep dips. Never settles. 3:2 polyrhythm layer over the kick in the peaks.

sections.name: Finale (dark coda)
sections.notes: Hard cut to near-silence, then the dark material fades in. Three-stage lowpass execution: sub+percussion drop, one breathing filter sweep, final slam. End on weight — sub-bass as the last word, no fade, no resolution. Close on VII, not the tonic.

status: analyzed — 12 sections from full multi-agent analysis (structure/rhythm/harmony/timbre/dynamics/transcription), 2026-11-05
